Oh, I thought I was supposed to destroy that
giraffe-looking hunk of junk.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 哦，我还以为要打倒那个长得像长颈鹿的废铁家伙呢。<08>

key:
If we destroy their energy source first, it will make
our job a lot easier later on. Especially for you.<08>
source_text:
If we destroy their energy source first, it will make
our job a lot easier later on. Especially for you.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 先破坏敌人的能源核心，之后的行动就会轻松许多，尤其是对你来说。<08>

key:
I'd rather take them out one by one-sort of like
knocking down dominoes, you know. <08><04>It's much less stressful that way.<08>
source_text:
I'd rather take them out one by one-sort of like
knocking down dominoes, you know. <08><04>It's much less stressful that way.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 我倒更喜欢像推倒多米诺骨牌一样把它们一个个清掉，你懂的。<08><04>那样反而没那么大压力。<08>

key:
Let's just do it.
Also, watch out for the laser traps.<08>
source_text:
Let's just do it.
Also, watch out for the laser traps.<08>
translation_zh_CN:
开始行动吧。
另外，小心附近的激光陷阱。<08>

key: Don't worry. I prefer to stay in one piece, too.<08>
source_text: Don't worry. I prefer to stay in one piece, too.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 放心，我也不想被切得支离破碎。<08>

key:
There's an energy field that surrounds the energy
reactor.<08><04>Shoot the core when there's an opening in the
energy field.<08>
source_text:
There's an energy field that surrounds the energy
reactor.<08><04>Shoot the core when there's an opening in the
energy field.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 能量反应堆周围覆盖着防护力场。<08><04>趁力场出现破绽的瞬间射击核心！<08>

key:
Good job.
Maybe I should hire you privately?<08>
source_text:
Good job.
Maybe I should hire you privately?<08>
translation_zh_CN:
干得漂亮。
也许我该私人长期雇佣你？<08>
这就是你的下一个目标。<08><0d>

key: I think you can handle it this time.<08>
source_text: I think you can handle it this time.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 这次你应该能顺利摆平它。<08>

key:
I can see you're not very good at motivation.<08><04>I'm gonna need a big fat bonus for this one, you
know.<08>
source_text:
I can see you're not very good at motivation.<08><04>I'm gonna need a big fat bonus for this one, you
know.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 看来你可真不太懂得如何鼓舞士气。<08><04>这一单我可是要狠狠要一笔丰厚奖金的，你懂吧。<08>

key:
It could be better, if you didn't keep interrupting me
all the time with your damn transmissions.<08>
source_text:
It could be better, if you didn't keep interrupting me
all the time with your damn transmissions.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 要是你不老是用那该死的通讯打断我，本来能更顺利些。<08>

key:
Alrighty then we'll do this without a briefing this
time.<08>
source_text:
Alrighty then we'll do this without a briefing this
time.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 那好吧，这次我们就省掉任务简报了。<08>

key: You sure can be a pain sometimes.<08>
source_text: You sure can be a pain sometimes.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 你有时候还真是够令人头疼的。<08>

key:
Come on now, does sending an "innocent girl" like
yourself into battle sound like something a "nice<08><04>woman" would do?<08>
source_text:
Come on now, does sending an "innocent girl" like
yourself into battle sound like something a "nice<08><04>woman" would do?<08>
translation_zh_CN: 得了吧，把你这样一位“纯真少女”派上战场，听起来像是“温柔<08><04>女性”会做的事吗？<08>

key:
The mushroom shaped floater enemy is capable of
scanning your combat data and sending it to other<08><04>enemy units.<08>
source_text:
The mushroom shaped floater enemy is capable of
scanning your combat data and sending it to other<08><04>enemy units.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 那个蘑菇状的浮游敌机能够扫描你的战斗数据并传输给其他<08><04>敌方单位。<08>

key: So I should get rid of them first.<08>
source_text: So I should get rid of them first.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 也就是说我该优先解决它们。<08>

key:
You catch on quick.
Talk to you later.<08>
source_text:
You catch on quick.
Talk to you later.<08>
translation_zh_CN:
领悟得真快。
回头再聊。<08>

key:
The front hatch is locked.
You have to go through the hatch above you.<08>
source_text:
The front hatch is locked.
You have to go through the hatch above you.<08>
translation_zh_CN:
正前方的舱门已经上锁。
你必须从上方的舱口绕行。<08>
正面舱门后面是什么地方？<08>

key:
I'll save that one for later.
Just do as I say okay?<08>
source_text:
I'll save that one for later.
Just do as I say okay?<08>
translation_zh_CN:
这个悬念先留到之后揭晓。
照我说的去做就好，行吗？<08>
这下我可得多拿点奖金才行。<08>

key:
I've put in some new Aegis Suits in the shop.
You should check it out.<08>
source_text:
I've put in some new Aegis Suits in the shop.
You should check it out.<08>
translation_zh_CN:
我已经在商店上架了几款全新神盾装甲。
有空记得去看看。<08>

key: I will when I feel like it.<08>
source_text: I will when I feel like it.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 等我有兴致了自然会去。<08>

key:
Have you gotten yourself a new suit?<08><04>The suits take a bit of getting used to but I'm sure
you'll do okay.<08>
source_text:
Have you gotten yourself a new suit?<08><04>The suits take a bit of getting used to but I'm sure
you'll do okay.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 你换上新装甲了吗？<08><04>新装甲可能需要时间适应手感，但我相信你没问题的。<08>

key: I've gotten used to you haven't I?<08>
source_text: I've gotten used to you haven't I?<08>
translation_zh_CN: 连你我都已经习惯了，不是吗？<08>

key:
Don't get smart with me.
Just remember who's got your paycheck.<08>
source_text:
Don't get smart with me.
Just remember who's got your paycheck.<08>
translation_zh_CN:
别跟我贫嘴。
记住是谁给你发薪水的。<08>

key:
I forgot to mention an important thing. This mission
will take place outside.<08><04>Your objective is to destroy the core of the
enemy units' insertion point.<08>
source_text:
I forgot to mention an important thing. This mission
will take place outside.<08><04>Your objective is to destroy the core of the
enemy units' insertion point.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 差点忘了说一件重要事：本次任务将在室外区域进行。<08><04>你的目标是摧毁敌军投放点核心。<08>

key:
Fresh air for a change. But you know my shades will
get dirty outside.<08>
source_text:
Fresh air for a change. But you know my shades will
get dirty outside.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 难得呼吸下新鲜空气。不过到了外面，我的墨镜可是会弄脏的。<08>

key: I'm taking the day off tomorrow. If you don't mind.<08>
source_text: I'm taking the day off tomorrow. If you don't mind.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 如果不介意的话，我明天休假一天。<08>

key: Did you buy yourself a new pair of sunglasses?<08>
source_text: Did you buy yourself a new pair of sunglasses?<08>
translation_zh_CN: 顺便给自己买副新太阳镜了吗？<08>
我的下一个任务是什么？<08>

key:
Destroy the CAMS' command tower. Its core
should be at the top level.<08><04>I have some unfinished business to take care of so
no complaints. Okay?<08>
source_text:
Destroy the CAMS' command tower. Its core
should be at the top level.<08><04>I have some unfinished business to take care of so
no complaints. Okay?<08>
translation_zh_CN: 摧毁 CAMS 的指挥塔，它的核心就在顶层。<08><04>我还有点未了的私事要处理，别抱怨，行吗？<08>

key: Looks kind of like a train almost.<08>
source_text: Looks kind of like a train almost.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 看起来简直活像一列火车。<08>

key: You'll find out soon enough if it's a train or not.<08>
source_text: You'll find out soon enough if it's a train or not.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 是不是火车，你很快就会亲自见识到了。<08>

key: All I have to do is destroy it, right?<08>
source_text: All I have to do is destroy it, right?<08>
translation_zh_CN: 只要把它毁掉就行，对吧？<08>

key: How are you holding up?<08><04>There are 2 exits. But one of those is locked.<08>
source_text: How are you holding up?<08><04>There are 2 exits. But one of those is locked.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 撑得住吗？<08><04>这里有 2 个出口，但其中一个处于锁定状态。<08>

key: Aren't you going to tell me which one?<08>
source_text: Aren't you going to tell me which one?<08>
translation_zh_CN: 你不打算告诉我到底是哪一个吗？<08>

key:
I think you're old enough to figure it out for
yourself.<08>
source_text:
I think you're old enough to figure it out for
yourself.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 我想你已经够成熟，能自己找到答案了。<08>

key:
This time I want you to take care of a job that
was left unfinished.<08>
source_text:
This time I want you to take care of a job that
was left unfinished.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 这一次，我要你去解决一桩先前未完的工作。<08>

key:
There was one area you couldn't access since it
was locked.<08><04>I've managed to unlock it. Go in and destroy the
core.<08>
source_text:
There was one area you couldn't access since it
was locked.<08><04>I've managed to unlock it. Go in and destroy the
core.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 之前有一处区域因被封锁而无法进入。<08><04>我已经设法替你解锁了。进去摧毁里面的核心。<08>

key:
The enemies in this area are expected to be much
tougher than when you last infiltrated the area.<08><04>Be careful.<08>
source_text:
The enemies in this area are expected to be much
tougher than when you last infiltrated the area.<08><04>Be careful.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 该区域的敌人预计比你上次潜入时更加棘手。<08><04>务必小心。<08>

key:
I've managed to unlock the front hatch.
Go through there.<08>
source_text:
I've managed to unlock the front hatch.
Go through there.<08>
translation_zh_CN:
我已经成功解锁正面舱门。
直接从那里进去。<08>

key: Are you going to tell me what it is?<08>
source_text: Are you going to tell me what it is?<08>
translation_zh_CN: 这次能告诉我那究竟是什么了吗？<08>

key:
I can't transport you directly to where the target
is so you'll have to infiltrate from the outside.<08>
source_text:
I can't transport you directly to where the target
is so you'll have to infiltrate from the outside.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 我无法直接把你传送到目标位置，你必须从外部突入潜行。<08>

key:
When you are transported, the sun will be on the
other side of the planet. It'll be dark so watch out<08><04>for the searchlights.<08><04>If they spot you, the night will turn into a shooting
spree and you will be the target!<08>
source_text:
When you are transported, the sun will be on the
other side of the planet. It'll be dark so watch out<08><04>for the searchlights.<08><04>If they spot you, the night will turn into a shooting
spree and you will be the target!<08>
translation_zh_CN: 当你被传送抵达时，太阳正位于行星背面。四周会很暗，千万避开<08><04>探照灯。<08><04>一旦被发现，整片夜色就会变成枪林弹雨，而你就是唯一靶子！<08>

key:
I was able to unlock the door that was locked in
your previous mission.<08><04>Sorry but I'm afraid you need to go there again.<08>
source_text:
I was able to unlock the door that was locked in
your previous mission.<08><04>Sorry but I'm afraid you need to go there again.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 我把你上次任务中锁着的那扇门打开了。<08><04>抱歉，恐怕你还得再去那里跑一趟。<08>

key:
This isn't a very efficient way of working you
know. Plus I think using the transportator is bad for<08><04>my skin.<08>
source_text:
This isn't a very efficient way of working you
know. Plus I think using the transportator is bad for<08><04>my skin.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 这种工作方式可真不算高效。而且我觉得老用传送装置对<08><04>我的皮肤可不太好。<08>

key:
Anyway, this time it'll be like a walk in the park.<08><04>There are life signs coming from inside the CAMS
facility.<08>
source_text:
Anyway, this time it'll be like a walk in the park.<08><04>There are life signs coming from inside the CAMS
facility.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 不管怎样，这次任务就像饭后散步一样轻松。<08><04>CAMS 设施内部侦测到了生命反应。<08>

key: Don't know.<08><04>I want you to investigate it.<08>
source_text: Don't know.<08><04>I want you to investigate it.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 还不清楚。<08><04>我要你进去一探究竟。<08>

key:
How's it going?<08><04>This time getting in is easy. Just use the front
entrance.<08>
source_text:
How's it going?<08><04>This time getting in is easy. Just use the front
entrance.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 情况如何？<08><04>这次潜入简单得多，直接走正门就行。<08>

key: I bet you're not going to tell me the way.<08>
source_text: I bet you're not going to tell me the way.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 我赌你多半又不会给我指路。<08>

key:
You said it'd be like a walk in the park. But it wasn't
that easy.<08>
source_text:
You said it'd be like a walk in the park. But it wasn't
that easy.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 你嘴上说是饭后散步，实际上哪有这么轻松。<08>

key: But it's more exciting that way. Don't you think?<08>
source_text: But it's more exciting that way. Don't you think?<08>
translation_zh_CN: 不过那样不是更有刺激感吗，你不觉得？<08>

key: Why is there someone that looks exactly like me?<08>
source_text: Why is there someone that looks exactly like me?<08>
translation_zh_CN: 为什么那里会有一个长得和我一模一样的人？<08>
看起来她还有生命体征。<08>

key:
Well, the CAMS self-destruct located in that area
has been activated.<08><04>You can exit using the Energy Pod I've located. It's
on your way out.<08><04>Also I've turned on the green emergency lighting on
the doors. That's your guide to the Energy Pod.<08>
source_text:
Well, the CAMS self-destruct located in that area
has been activated.<08><04>You can exit using the Energy Pod I've located. It's
on your way out.<08><04>Also I've turned on the green emergency lighting on
the doors. That's your guide to the Energy Pod.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 嗯，那个区域的 CAMS 自毁程序已经被触发了。<08><04>你可以借助我定位到的能量逃生舱撤离，它就在你出去的路上。<08><04>另外我打开了门上的绿色应急指示灯，跟着它就能找到逃生舱。<08>

key: How much time do I have?<08>
source_text: How much time do I have?<08>

key:
5 minutes.
Better forget about trying to rescue her. There's<08><04>no time for that.<08>
source_text:
5 minutes.
Better forget about trying to rescue her. There's<08><04>no time for that.<08>
translation_zh_CN:
5 分钟。
别再想着去救她了，现在根本<08><04>没有多余的时间。<08>
刚才那一切到底是怎么回事？<08>

key:
Oh you mean the subject we had to leave behind?
That was very unfortunate.<08>
source_text:
Oh you mean the subject we had to leave behind?
That was very unfortunate.<08>
translation_zh_CN:
哦，你是说不得不留在里面的那个实验体吗？
真是万分可惜。<08>

告诉我……
我究竟是谁？<08>

key: Okay, we'll talk about it when this is all over.<08>
source_text: Okay, we'll talk about it when this is all over.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 好吧，等这一切都结束后，我再把真相全都告诉你。<08>

key: Because I'm your client.<08><04>I think your mission is almost over.<08>
source_text: Because I'm your client.<08><04>I think your mission is almost over.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 因为我是你的委托人。<08><04>我想，你的任务很快就要画上句号了。<08>

key: Are you going to let me go?<08>
source_text: Are you going to let me go?<08>

key:
When it's all over.<08><04>Find and destroy the Energy Reactor. The passage
forks out in many directions so be careful.<08>
source_text:
When it's all over.<08><04>Find and destroy the Energy Reactor. The passage
forks out in many directions so be careful.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 一切结束之时自会兑现。<08><04>找到并摧毁能量反应堆。前方通道岔路众多，务必小心。<08>

key: Thanks but I'll go as I please.<08>
source_text: Thanks but I'll go as I please.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 谢了，但我历来随心而行。<08>

key:
Alraune, the CAMS central core is your target.
Destroy it.<08>
source_text:
Alraune, the CAMS central core is your target.
Destroy it.<08>
translation_zh_CN:
奥拉涅（Alraune），CAMS 的中枢核心就是你的目标。
摧毁它。<08>
终于轮到幕后头目出场了……<08>

key: Congratulations on a job well done.<08>
source_text: Congratulations on a job well done.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 干得漂亮，任务圆满成功。<08>

key: Go through the hatch in the back.<08>
source_text: Go through the hatch in the back.<08>

key:
How have you been?
It's been half a year since we last spoke.<08>
source_text:
How have you been?
It's been half a year since we last spoke.<08>
translation_zh_CN:
最近过得怎么样？
自上次通话以来，转眼已经过去半年了。<08>

key:
I'm on vacation.
So find someone else for your job.<08>
source_text:
I'm on vacation.
So find someone else for your job.<08>
translation_zh_CN:
我正在休假呢。
这单活你还是另请高明吧。<08>

key:
How did you know I was going to ask you to do a
job?<08>
source_text:
How did you know I was going to ask you to do a
job?<08>
translation_zh_CN: 你怎么知道我正想找你接新任务？<08>

key: With you it's all business, no pleasure.<08>
source_text: With you it's all business, no pleasure.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 跟你打交道永远只有公事，半点乐趣也没有。<08>

key:
Your intuition must have something to do with us
having the same DNA.<08>
source_text:
Your intuition must have something to do with us
having the same DNA.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 你这份直觉，大概跟我们拥有相同的 DNA 有关吧。<08>
总之，如果没什么别的事，我就先挂了……<08>

key: That's not a nice way to treat your client.<08>
source_text: That's not a nice way to treat your client.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 这么对待你的雇主可不太礼貌啊。<08>

key: Don't give me a hard time.<08>
source_text: Don't give me a hard time.<08>

key: Right.<08><04>Maybe I'll call again at a later time then.<08>
source_text: Right.<08><04>Maybe I'll call again at a later time then.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 好吧。<08><04>那我过段时间再联系你吧。<08>

key:
Not in the shower please.
How about some privacy?<08>
source_text:
Not in the shower please.
How about some privacy?<08>
translation_zh_CN:
拜托，洗澡的时候别来偷看行吗？
尊重一下别人隐私好不好？<08>

key:
What's there to hide.
We have identical bodies.<08>
source_text:
What's there to hide.
We have identical bodies.<08>
translation_zh_CN:
有什么好遮掩的。
我们的身体本来就一模一样。<08>

纹身挺漂亮的。
为什么选了蝴蝶？<08>

key: I'll leave it to your imagination.<08><04>You know I never asked your name.<08>
source_text: I'll leave it to your imagination.<08><04>You know I never asked your name.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 留给你自己想象吧。<08><04>说起来，我好像一直没问过你的名字。<08>

key: Maybe we're of the same descent.<08>
source_text: Maybe we're of the same descent.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 或许我们出自同一血脉。<08>

key: You're you and I'm me. Right?<08>
source_text: You're you and I'm me. Right?<08>

key: Right but I sense something else is on your mind.<08>
source_text: Right but I sense something else is on your mind.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 没错，但我感觉你心里还藏着别的心事。<08>

key:
I'll do it if I'm your client this time and you do all the
fighting.<08>
source_text:
I'll do it if I'm your client this time and you do all the
fighting.<08>
translation_zh_CN: 除非这次换我当委托人，所有战斗都由你亲自上阵。<08>
我来为你说明下一个任务。<08>
你从来都不听人把话说完，对吧？<08>

key:
Change and power-up your Aegis Suit.
Buy new Aegis Suits and Extra Continues.
source_text:
Change and power-up your Aegis Suit.
Buy new Aegis Suits and Extra Continues.
translation_zh_CN:
更换或强化你的神盾装甲，
购买全新装甲与额外续关次数。

key:
The Trial Mission will allow you to hone your techniques
and earn extra points.
source_text:
The Trial Mission will allow you to hone your techniques
and earn extra points.
translation_zh_CN: 模拟实战任务可让你磨炼战斗技巧并赚取额外点数。

key: Execute your next mission- Mission No.<0a>
source_text: Execute your next mission- Mission No.<0a>
translation_zh_CN: 开始执行下一项任务 — 任务编号 <0a>
正在保存……请勿关闭电源。
正在读取……请勿拔出记忆卡。
没有发现 P.N.03 的存档数据。
插槽 A 中未检测到记忆卡。
确定要覆盖当前存档数据吗？
